subject: Customer-facing accountability report and verification checklist — StellarPay latency anomaly
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@stellarpay.com>, support@stellarpay.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Customer-facing accountability report and verification checklist — StellarPay latency anomaly

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the patience while we completed our analysis. Attached is a concise, customer-facing accountability report and a short verification checklist you can run on your traffic this week. High-level summary up front:

- Impact: brief latency elevation on inference endpoints for a subset of ShortSeq workloads between 2027-04-15 22:07 UTC and 2027-04-16 03:40 UTC; median tail latency increased from ~18ms to ~95ms for affected requests.
- Root cause: a multi-factor regression where a new kernel selection heuristic deployed on 2027-04-15 favored an uncommon kernel path for models with large KV-cache footprints; under a narrow sequence-length and concurrency pattern this triggered repeated micro-recompiles and degraded throughput.
- Customer impact: ~2.7% of StellarPay inference calls during the window experienced >250ms p95 and occasional timeouts; no data exfiltration or model correctness change.

What we are delivering to you now:
1) A concise RCA PDF (attached) with timeline, technical findings, and a remediation ledger.
2) A verification checklist (attached XLSX) with queries you can run against the traces/metrics we shipped to your S3 bucket and the sample request ids we included.
3) A permanent mitigation we rolled out on 2027-04-17 03:02 UTC that pins kernel-selection to the previous stable heuristic for the affected model family; we have also added an A/B guardrail to prevent the heuristic from taking effect on low-volume sequences.

Immediate asks for StellarPay:
- Run the verification checklist against the sample IDs in sheet "Samples" and reply with the verification rows (pass/fail) by Friday 2027-04-23.
- If you'd like a short technical walk-through, we can schedule a 30-minute session with our runtime engineers (I suggest Tuesday 2027-04-26).

I realize any interruption is costly — we are committed to transparent remediation and to an ops-level credit for the impacted window as per your contract. Details on compensation mechanics are in the RCA doc and we'll coordinate with your procurement contact if required.

Attachments: 2027-04-21-StellarPay-RCA.pdf (RCA summary, timeline, remediation ledger), validation-checklist-2027-04-21.xlsx (verification queries + sample IDs).

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Emma Liu <emma.liu@stellarpay.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Customer-facing accountability report and verification checklist — StellarPay latency anomaly

Hannah — quick add: the RCA includes the exact kernel metrics (compile counts, compile latencies) for the sample window. Emma, if you want the raw trace export we pushed to your S3 prefix, the path is in the Drive link Hannah attached.

I'll be on the Tech Deep Dive if you schedule one — I can walk through the kernel-selection codepath and the guardrail we added.

— Jonas
Senior Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@stellarpay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@stellarpay.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 14:04:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Customer-facing accountability report and verification checklist — StellarPay latency anomaly

Hannah / Jonas — thank you for the thorough write-up. A couple of quick clarifications from our side after an initial pass: 

1) The sample IDs: can you confirm which environment these came from (prod vs stage)? We want to ensure we validate against production traces.
2) On the mitigation: will the kernel-selection pin be applied to all of our production regions or only the us-east region where we saw the spike?
3) Can you provide the list of affected model-version IDs so we can cross-check against our model routing table?

We will start running the verification checklist tomorrow and loop back with the pass/fail table. Our goal is to confirm by Friday EOD (2027-04-23). Also we appreciate the compensation offer; I will route that to procurement but we may ask for an itemized downtime estimate to match our billing reconciliation.

Best,
Emma Liu
Head of Platform Reliability
StellarPay

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@stellarpay.com>, support@stellarpay.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 10:20:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Customer-facing accountability report and verification checklist — StellarPay latency anomaly

Emma — thanks, quick answers inline: 

1) Samples: the sample_ids sheet contains production request ids; the file header explicitly marks them as taken from the production export (S3 prefix: s3://redwood-customer-exports/stellarpay/prod/2027-04-15). We also included a smaller stage sample next to each prod id for comparison.

2) Mitigation scope: the rollback/pin was applied globally to the model family at 2027-04-17 03:02 UTC (all regions). We first observed the anomaly in us-east because that region services more short-seq traffic for StellarPay, but the mitigation is global.

3) Affected model-version IDs: MV-2027-04-A3, MV-2027-04-A3-quant, MV-2027-04-B1. These are listed in the RCA PDF appendix (page 4).

Next steps: 
- Please send the verification table (sheet "VerificationResults") with pass/fail per sample by Fri EOD.
- If you prefer we run the checklist from our side and send back the completed sheet, we can do that as a customer-assisted verification; let me know and we'll schedule a short window when your traffic is at normal rates.

If you're comfortable, I'm happy to put a 30-minute Tech Deep Dive on the calendar for Tue 2027-04-26 15:00 UTC. Jonas and Grace will join.

Regards,
Hannah
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027-04-21-StellarPay-RCA.pdf (section references), validation-checklist-2027-04-21.xlsx (please use "VerificationResults" sheet)

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@stellarpay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@stellarpay.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Customer-facing accountability report and verification checklist — StellarPay latency anomaly

Hannah / team — confirmed receipt and we completed the checklist. Short summary: all prod sample_ids passed verification except two samples where we saw elevated p95 in our logs (rows 18 and 19 in VerificationResults). We attached our filled sheet to the reply (we also uploaded the logs to the S3 prefix you provided).

We'd like the Tech Deep Dive on Tue 2027-04-26 — 15:00 UTC works. Please send a calendar invite. For the compensation estimate, I'll share our reconciliation template with procurement by early next week.

Thank you for the clear report and for the rapid mitigation. Appreciated.

— Emma
Head of Platform Reliability
StellarPay
